query:
UPDATE memories
            SET energy = GREATEST(0, CAST(
                (energy::double precision) * EXP((-($1::double precision)) * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - (last_energy_update)::timestamptz)) / 3600.0)
                AS INTEGER
            )),
            last_energy_update = NOW()
            WHERE status = 'active'
              AND energy > 0
              AND last_energy_update < NOW()
